source_name: zib.com.ua / dtkt.ua / ligazakon — legal-trade commentary on NBU personnel-approval rule changes
why_relevant: Legal trade press explains changes to the NBU procedure for approving bank managers (document packages, nostrification requirements, acting-manager rules) — context needed to interpret volume shifts in approvals.

source_name: tender.uub.com.ua — per-company Prozorro tender mirror (NBU, Oschadbank, branches)
why_relevant: Convenient per-buyer aggregation pages for NBU (EDRPOU 00032106), Oschadbank (00032129) and its regional branches, plus explainer content on consulting tenders in Prozorro. Useful as a quick index and for discovering EDRPOU codes; the authoritative record remains Prozorro.

Ranking project on Ukrainian banks whose analytical write-ups typically quote named board members by title, providing periodic corroboration of who holds which role and how banks describe their own org priorities.

source_name: DOU.ua forums — fintech/banking IT management discussions
why_relevant: Ukrainian IT community platform whose threads discuss management of bank/fintech tech projects from the inside. Reveals-indirectly category: practitioners name teams, reorganizations and hiring conditions that neither banks nor business media publish. Noisy and unverified, but a leading indicator for org changes below board level.

source_name: ANCOR (Анкор Персонал Україна) — огляди заробітних плат, пільг і компенсацій
why_relevant: Staffing group with a Ukrainian entity that sells salary/benefits benchmarking surveys and (historically) ran Randstad Employer Brand Research in Ukraine — a paid but methodologically structured comp benchmark relevant to bank back-office and retail roles.
General Ukrainian business group where finance professionals post role changes and recruit; a lower-signal but open venue for spotting mid-level banking/payments moves and vacancies.

Political-insider channel that frequently trails appointments to state-owned banks (Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank) and the NBU before formal announcement. Unattributed, so treat as hypothesis-generating only.
Broadcaster site that carried the government dismissal of the Sens Bank supervisory-board chair; low unique value but broad, and occasionally publishes video/quote material absent from text outlets.

entity_name: National Association of Credit Unions of Ukraine
source_name: National Association of Credit Unions of Ukraine (NAKSU)
why_relevant: The second national credit-union association (also indexed at unascu.org.ua), distinct from VAKS. Completes the cooperative-finance actor map and provides an English-language section, useful for cross-language name resolution of the same executives.

Indexes Ukrainian company filings in English with officer records; useful for cross-border name matching and for analysts without Ukrainian, but it lags the official register and must not be treated as compliance-grade or as a primary timing signal.

X is a minor channel for Ukrainian banking personnel news (the community sits on Telegram/Facebook/LinkedIn), but English-language posts by international-facing bankers and NBU officials occasionally appear there first for foreign audiences.

source_name: Yurydychna Gazeta (yur-gazeta.com) — legal-professional coverage of Cabinet governance acts
why_relevant: Legal trade press that reports Cabinet appointment orders on state-bank supervisory boards with the act reference and legal framing, which helps locate the underlying розпорядження on zakon.rada.gov.ua when the Cabinet news item is thin.
